description: The Lexmark T640, T642, T644, W840, C920, C534, C772, X644e, X646e, X646dte, X850e, X852e, and X854e Cryptographic Platforms provide the cryptographic solution for the printer's secure printing capabilities. The implementation offers secure print jobs using the Advanced Encryption Standard (FIPS 197) algorithm and RSA key wrapping.
